findings.problem: Lines 66–94 prove, inline, that a ring map φ : A →ₐ[R] R whose kernel I has I.Cotangent free of rank 1 has some t₀ with φ t₀ = 0 and I ≤ span{t₀} ⊔ I^2. The proof picks a basis of I.Cotangent, lifts b 0 to t, writes the class of y as cR • (class of t), and shows y − cR • t ∈ I^2 via `Ideal.toCotangent_eq_zero`. The identical statement and argument already exist as `P2Body.GenKerAux.exists_generator`, which is proved separately in two other files. The target reproves it a third time. The target does so with extra clutter: it rebuilds `Module.Finite` from `finrank_pos`, uses a `Fin 1` basis with `Fin.sum_univ_one`, and states the full `sectionAlgHom (σ i) (hσ.comp_eq i) (hσ.range_subset i)` expression three times inside the existential. The sub-proof is about 30 lines inside a theorem that is otherwise a chain of API calls. It is a general fact about ker(A →ₐ[R] R) and has nothing to do with Laurent charts.
findings.proposed_change: Move the generator argument into one shared lemma in a neutral file. Do not keep it in the `P2Body.GenKerAux` namespace of either of the two files that also contain `stalkAlgebra` and `Lpi`. The lemma is `theorem exists_generator {R A : Type*} [CommRing R] [Nontrivial R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] (e : A →ₐ[R] R) [Module.Free R (RingHom.ker e.toRingHom).Cotangent] (he : Module.finrank R (RingHom.ker e.toRingHom).Cotangent = 1) : ∃ t₀ : A, e t₀ = 0 ∧ RingHom.ker e.toRingHom ≤ Ideal.span {t₀} ⊔ RingHom.ker e.toRingHom ^ 2`. Prove it with the existing short proof: `Module.basisUnique Unit he`, `Ideal.toCotangent_surjective`, and `Submodule.add_mem_sup` applied to `Ideal.toCotangent_eq`. `Nontrivial R` follows from `IsLocalRing R` in the target. Then replace lines 66–94 with `obtain ⟨hfree, hrank⟩ := free_cotangent_sectionAlgHom …` followed by `obtain ⟨t₀, ht₀, hgen⟩ := exists_generator (sectionAlgHom (σ i) (hσ.comp_eq i) (hσ.range_subset i)) hrank`, using `haveI := hfree`. Also replace the proof at line 278 of the first file below and line 406 of the second with calls to the shared lemma.
findings.benefit: The cotangent-generator reasoning is stated and maintained once instead of three times. The target's `hchart` shrinks from about 40 lines to a few and no longer repeats the long `sectionAlgHom (σ i) (hσ.comp_eq i) (hσ.range_subset i)` expression inside the existential. A reader sees that the rank-one cotangent step is a standard lemma, so the file's own content is the Laurent chart, completion and Serre pairing argument.
